zh-CN.title: 管理页面，更清爽
items: 成员管理整合搜索、筛选与统计，空间设置减少重复标题和多层卡片
权限编辑采用扁平布局，手机可收起能力目录，继承规则按需查看，并完善深色模式

en.title: Cleaner administration pages
items: Member management combines search, filters and counts, while space settings lose repeated headings and nested cards
A flatter permission editor with a collapsible mobile directory, expandable inherited rules and consistent dark-mode styling
